news.title: Mizzou researcher gives pork producers an edge against extreme heat
news.summary_en: Jay Johnson received a $1.15 million USDA grant to expand his HotHog app, which helps producers mitigate heat stress on pigs.

news.title: Mizzou’s sunflower display has become a favorite tradition
news.summary_en: Visit the University of Missouri's South Farm to see the annual display of blooming sunflowers — this year features three waves of blooms to enjoy.
